products.color: Pale fragrance / clear oval bottle / black cap
materials: Sandalwood, cedar, cypress and coriander notes
products.priceEvidence: Live official U.S. product HTML identifies SKU TAMDAOP75CV1, Eau de parfum, 75 ml. Product JSON-LD lists offers.price 260.0 and priceCurrency USD; the visible product panel also shows 75 ml and US $260.
products.introEn: Tam Dao gives a woody fragrance wardrobe a particularly clear point of reference. Diptyque presents its sandalwood through the memory of temple forests in Vietnam, with cedar, cypress and coriander around it. This 75 ml Eau de Parfum sits in the house’s oval bottle, where the densely lettered label and illustration turn a small object into something worth looking at from both sides. Consider it with textured linen or a soft, simple knit: an understated setting for a composition built around wood and spice.
featuresEn: 75 ml Eau de Parfum, official reference TAMDAOP75CV1.
The declared notes are sandalwood, cedar, cypress and coriander.
The oval glass bottle carries an illustrated label visible from the reverse.
products.stylingEn: Try it on skin before choosing a full bottle, then return to it as the fragrance develops. Use a small application with a linen shirt or relaxed tailoring, and adjust to your setting.
products.designer: Diptyque; the cited product page does not name the perfumer
productLimitations: The official product page does not state this Eau de Parfum variant’s launch year or perfumer; no year is inferred from the earlier Tam Dao family.

products.name: SANTAL 33 Eau de Parfum, 100 ml
products.nameZh: 勒莱柏 SANTAL 33 淡香精100毫升
products.color: Clear glass bottle / silver-toned cap / paper label
materials: Cardamom, iris, violet, Australian sandalwood and cedarwood notes
products.priceEvidence: Live official U.S. ProductGroup JSON-LD has a 100 ml variant with SKU 100PS33100, offers.price 348.00 and priceCurrency USD. Its separate 50 ml variant is $250 and is not used for this record.
products.introEn: SANTAL 33 is a useful way to explore the space between woods, spice and soft floral notes. Le Labo describes cardamom, iris and violet alongside Australian sandalwood and cedarwood, then adds leathery and musky facets to its account of the scent. The 100 ml bottle keeps the presentation direct: clear glass, a metal-colored cap and a label that resembles a working laboratory record. Set it beside denim, cotton and an uncomplicated jacket, and let your own skin test decide how the composition fits your day.
featuresEn: 100 ml Eau de Parfum, official SKU 100PS33100.
The brand names cardamom, iris, violet, Australian sandalwood and cedarwood.
The official gallery shows the bottle, the application of its paper label and its box.
products.stylingEn: Sample it on skin and allow time for the woody and floral facets to settle before judging. Pair the mood with worn denim or a plain cotton shirt, keeping the application considerate of close company.
productLimitations: The 2011 date and Frank Voelkl attribution are supported by the perfumer’s official dsm-firmenich portfolio; the current product page supplies the concentration, size, notes and price.

materials: Bergamot, African marigold and blackcurrant notes
products.priceEvidence: Live official U.S. raw HTML ProductGroup JSON-LD identifies current SKU 0065204863, size 100 ml, offers.price 330 and priceCurrency USD. products.introEn: Bal d’Afrique gives a fragrance wardrobe a lively floral and woody direction. Byredo describes bright bergamot, African marigold and blackcurrant leading into violet and cyclamen, followed by cedarwood and vetiver. The 100 ml bottle pairs a clear cylindrical body with a rounded black cap and a restrained white label. Its clean visual rhythm works naturally beside pale cotton and relaxed tailoring, while the story behind the scent invites a more personal choice than matching a perfume to a dress code.
featuresEn: 100 ml Eau de Parfum, current U.S. SKU 0065204863.
Declared top notes include bergamot, African marigold and blackcurrant.
Cedarwood, vetiver, musks and tonka bean appear in the base.
products.stylingEn: Try it with a linen shirt, loose trousers and a simple leather sandal. Sample it on skin first, allowing its floral and woody elements to develop before choosing your usual amount.

products.sourceSnapshotNote: Official Maison Francis Kurkdjian U.S. product reader snapshot accessed on 2026-10-27 and reported crawled today. Direct raw static requests to MFK returned HTTP403. The USD360 amount is corroborated by live Baccarat U.S. product HTML; no checkout was performed.
products.introEn: Baccarat Rouge 540 connects perfume with the visual language of crystal. Its Eau de Parfum balances jasmine and saffron facets with ambery, mineral and dry woody accords, an idea Francis Kurkdjian relates to air, fire and transformed material. The 70 ml presentation places a red label and a small gold cap against a clear square bottle. Consider it as a richly colored accent within an otherwise simple wardrobe, with the bottle itself offering a compact study in transparency and warm metal.
featuresEn: 70 ml / 2.4 fl.oz. Eau de Parfum natural spray, MFK reference RA12232.
The composition is described through floral, ambery and woody facets.
Its three-aura concept connects jasmine accents, mineral woods and gourmand warmth.
products.stylingEn: Pair its warm visual character with a black knit, a fluid skirt or a sharply cut jacket. Start with a small skin trial so the scent can settle before an occasion.
productLimitations: Named notes and accords describe the brand’s scent profile, not its complete formula; projection and wear time were not tested.

products.introEn: Wood Sage & Sea Salt brings a coastal idea into a restrained rectangular bottle. Jo Malone London places ambrette seeds at the opening, sea salt at the heart and sage in the base, describing the result as a fresh woody scent inspired by the British shore. The 100 ml Cologne has a pale label and a polished silver cap that keep its presentation spare. It offers an appealing starting point for a scent wardrobe built around texture, open air and uncomplicated clothing.
featuresEn: Ambrette seeds, sea salt and sage form the declared note structure.
Designed to be worn alone or layered with another Jo Malone London Cologne.
products.stylingEn: Try it alongside a cotton poplin shirt, soft denim and a light cardigan. Explore it on its own first, then compare a small layered trial if you enjoy changing your scent.
